name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on detergents and surfactants, amending Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 and repealing Regulation (EC) No 648/2004
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved the Council's position on a new law on detergents and surfactants (the cleaning agents in detergents). This replaces the existing 2004 detergents regulation and updates another EU product rules regulation. Parliament's committee had already reached a deal with the Council, and the full Parliament has now backed it without changes. The report itself does not add new demands; it simply confirms the agreed text so the law can be finalised.

- **What changes:** A new EU law on detergents and surfactants replaces the 2004 detergents regulation.
- **Who it affects:** Companies making or selling detergents in the EU, and the authorities that check them.
- **What happens next:** The act is adopted; its presidents sign it and it is published in the EU Official Journal.
